section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that investigated the reliability and validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in 228 Black college women (mean age = 19.89). The study examined the relation between BAS scores and various measures, supporting the construct validity and a unidimensional factor structure. Ethnic identity was found to be moderately, positively associated with body appreciation, and Western beauty ideal internalization mediated the relation between ethnic identity and eating, weight, and shape concerns.
